acceptance_criteria.statement: The reader has a Plans section beside Documentation and Reviews that lists the Plans.
A reader on a Plan's page can tell from that page that it describes intended work and is not a Review.
A Plan's Tasks can link to stories in more than one feature.
Changing a Plan and committing it updates that Plan and does not create another.

content.statement: As a developer, I can find Plans in their own section beside Documentation and Reviews, so I can tell what we intend to do from what exists and what has changed.
content.title: Find Plans in their own section

state.reason: Verified against the code and tests on 2026-11-02. The Plans section lists Plans, a Plan's page says what it is, and a Plan crosses features and keeps one identity.
